method.fit_2026: Full Gibbs (gibbs.run_gibbs), agnostic preset, likelihood nu=5.0, 4 chains x (1000 warm-up + 2500 draws), Mundlak on, statewide deviations if >= 25 statewide rows. Rule/high-confidence label universes switch u_a off (as in 06 R3). OLS-FE/EB not needed: each fit takes a few seconds.
method.gap: delta_a = beta_L (Lbar_a - 1) + beta_P Pbar_a + u_a vs mainstream_liberal; [median, 10th, 90th] of posterior draws; points on the outcome scale of that universe (logit50 = points in an even seat).
method.engine_2028: reference_engine.v_dist at the 'even' environment t5(0,5), bank seed SEED+100, E seed SEED+101, generic opponent = average of non-MAGA and MAGA (as in 10_validate.headline). P_win = mean over style x pi draws; dV = 100 x (P_win[lane] - P_win[mainstream_liberal]) per draw, [median, 10th, 90th].
method.history_sources: competitive: history_comparison.competitive.env_model.logit[a].three_cycle.fe; all seats: headline.even_environment[a].gls_3cycle; drawn normal with 80% interval widened 1.5x (09_export). blend = alternate draws of the 2026 fit and competitive history.
